# ankra_application_settings (Resource)

The organisation's application CI settings: the runner label generated pipelines request, and whether Ankra merges an application's setup pull request itself once its checks pass. The counterpart of `ankra application settings set`. There is one per organisation and it needs an organisation admin. Destroying it restores the platform defaults: the default runner and no auto-merge.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_application_settings" "this" {
  ci_runner_label                = "self-hosted-linux"
  auto_merge_setup_pull_requests = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `auto_merge_setup_pull_requests` (Boolean) Whether Ankra merges an application's setup pull request once its checks pass. Defaults to `false`.
- `ci_runner_label` (String) GitHub Actions runner label generated pipelines run on. Unset uses Ankra's default runner.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `application_settings`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# There is one settings object per organisation.
terraform import ankra_application_settings.this application_settings
```
